context_requirements: Functional CCK1 (CCKAR) or CCK2 (CCKBR) receptor expression
A transcriptional program downstream of CCK receptor activation (e.g., immediate-early genes) that can be antagonized
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is reversed by CCK receptor agonists
Evidence of CCKAR or CCKBR expression and functional coupling in these lines
